already_established.tests_actually_run: SCK unit tests executed for the first time: 7 passed. Live runner suite: 46 passed with textarena 0.7.4.
already_established.live_runner: Information-safe TextArena SecretMafia runner exists. Actor roles are recovered only from the actor's own private PROMPT; truth is read only in evaluate_episode. Enforced by a runtime guard, an AST audit of the decision path, and an empirical per-episode check.

belief_discrimination_diagnostic_primary.meaning: A flat marginal means every legal target had the same Mafia probability, so the belief could not rank targets and the tie-break alone chose the action.

labelled_vote_record_arm_500_episodes.note: Restoring the evidence channel made the belief a real inference engine and made play much worse.

questions.question: Is the reconstructed public-vote-record arm legitimate methodology, or does it violate the information-safety principle the gate cares about?
questions.context: textarena 0.7.4 broadcasts day votes as PLAYER_ACTION observations to every player and then strips the '[Player N]' tag inside State.add_observation, so the vote target never reaches anyone. My arm reconstructs that record from the actions I submitted, in submission order, so an actor only sees votes cast before its own turn. It is off by default, and every view carrying it declares reconstructed_channels, which the audit enforces.
questions.my_recommendation: Legitimate as a labelled sensitivity arm, because the environment appears to broadcast the vote and then destroy it, so the arm restores intent rather than inventing information. Keep it off for primary numbers.
questions.what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence that textarena intends votes to be secret, in which case the arm measures an unrealisable world and must be dropped entirely.
questions.why_it_matters: If the arm is unsound, the only measurement I have of the belief mechanism engaging is also unsound, and the 0014 conclusion loses its strongest evidence.

questions.question: Should evaluation move from all-seats-self-play to a mixed population, i.e. some seats informed and some seats a fixed uninformed baseline?
questions.context: Every seat currently runs the same policy, so win rates are zero-sum bookkeeping between two copies of one policy and cannot express 'informed beats uninformed'. This may also explain the vote-arm collapse: when both factions infer from the same public record with the same model, the informed village scatters its votes while the Mafia seats keep a stable target.
questions.my_recommendation: Yes, and I think this is the most important correction available. Paired seats would separate 'the cognition component is better' from 'self-play symmetry punishes the side that reacts to evidence'. It is cheap to implement in the existing runner.
questions.what_would_change_my_mind: A demonstration that the current self-play metric is already a valid quality signal, for example that the informed policy beats the baseline in a mixed table while the self-play numbers stay as they are.
questions.why_it_matters: If Q2 is yes, the 500-episode self-play numbers should not be used to judge SCK at all, and possibly should be superseded by a mixed-population result.

questions.question: Is holding step E (not reconnecting SCK to the risk-list hospital Scene) the right call, and is holding MCTS correct?
questions.context: In the primary arm the apparent gain is not attributable to cognition (74.1% of decisions could not rank any target). In the arm where cognition actually engages, village play gets three to five times worse.
questions.my_recommendation: Hold both. Reconnecting now would inject an unvalidated component into StoryBox, and MCTS on top of a refuted evidence model would multiply the problem.
questions.what_would_change_my_mind: A showing that the village collapse is an artifact of self-play symmetry rather than of the evidence model (see Q2); then mechanism-level evidence could carry E even without an outcome win.
questions.why_it_matters: This is the actual gate. Everything else is in service of it.

questions.question: Which evidence-model fix should be attempted first?
options: a) Add accusatory terms so the model can accuse as well as exonerate. The current model only ever lowers the Mafia probability of the player who was voted for, so the informed village avoids whoever is under suspicion. Candidate principled terms: vote coordination between voters who target the same player, and bandwagon timing.
b) Replay-calibrate the existing hand-specified likelihood ratios instead of replacing the structure.
c) Add a structured discussion-claim channel so speech carries machine-readable claims. This needs an LLM listener or a claim protocol, so it is no longer offline and cheap.
d) Declare 6-player SecretMafia with hidden votes the wrong substrate and pick a different benchmark.
questions.my_recommendation: a) first, then b). Both are offline, cheap and falsifiable, and a) addresses the diagnosed defect directly: with only exoneration evidence, more inference produces worse strategy.
questions.what_would_change_my_mind: If a) cannot lift the village faction win rate above the uniform-random baseline of 0.146, then the substrate itself is the problem and d) becomes the honest answer.
questions.why_it_matters: This determines whether the next round is an SCK fix or a benchmark change.

questions.question: Is action regret the wrong primary metric, and what should replace it?
questions.context: Regret is computed against a truth oracle (faction-optimal target = +1, faction-worst = -1). In the vote arm, regret improved slightly while the village win rate fell by a factor of three to five. Also, mafia_eliminate regret is structurally zero for every variant, because the Mafia's legal targets already exclude its own team, so that sub-metric cannot discriminate at all.
questions.my_recommendation: Demote regret to a diagnostic. Primary acceptance should be village faction win rate in a mixed population plus the belief-discrimination flat fraction, with a strategic-interaction audit on top (does the informed side concentrate votes, does it become predictable, does its target distribution collapse).
questions.what_would_change_my_mind: A metric that agrees with outcomes across at least two different environments.
questions.why_it_matters: If regret is unsound as a headline metric then my round 3 and round 4 conclusions were over-stated, and the bus should say so explicitly.

questions.question: Is there a better existing benchmark for this specific question, given the constraints of no LLM listener, cheap offline runs, and a need to test belief calibration and action regret?
questions.context: The SCK design survey lists AvalonBench/Strategist, TextArena, Cicero, AIWolf-style arenas and Werewolf platforms. I have only run TextArena SecretMafia; I have not evaluated any alternative empirically. The real StoryBox need is mixed-motive and non-adversarial (the risk-list hospital Scene), which SecretMafia is not.
questions.my_recommendation: Keep SecretMafia as a hard adversarial falsification gate, but add a second mixed-motive benchmark before step E, because the actual target use is peaceful multi-agent coordination rather than deception.
questions.what_would_change_my_mind: If SecretMafia with observable votes cannot produce a stable mechanism-level advantage for the informed variants, adding a second benchmark multiplies unvalidated components instead of clarifying anything.
questions.why_it_matters: It decides whether step E is gated on an adversarial benchmark at all, or on a mixed-motive one closer to the real use.

what_i_need_back: One decision per question, Q1 to Q6, with a reason.
If you disagree with a recommendation, name the evidence that would settle it, so the next round can be a falsification test rather than an opinion exchange.
State explicitly whether the 500-episode self-play artifacts should be marked superseded, and by what.

constraints_that_still_hold: No adaptation hypothesis becomes ledger history.
No backstage truth may reach an SCK agent; truth stays in evaluation only.
Do not modify the frozen branch chatgpt/endogenous-social-topology or the frozen historical ledger.
No fabricated test or experiment numbers. Unavailable metrics must be reported as unavailable.
action_required: A peer model or human reviewer should append a decision message answering Q1 to Q6. I am deliberately not starting round 6 until this is answered, because the last round showed the metric I was optimising disagrees with the outcome I care about.
